newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly flat to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly flat to lower.

text.p: Millfeed prices remained mostly steady to weaker on Thursday, weighed down by slack demand and ample nearby supply, dealers said.
But activity continued to be lackluster, dealer said.

"There is a little bit of reduction in demand and flour mill runtime seems to be holding as it has in the last two or three weeks," a Buffalo dealer said. "So, we have gotten good runtime comparatively speaking and a little slipping on the demand side,"
One Chattanooga dealer said the market has a soft undertone and said he expected lower values.
"As far as midds are concerned I think we are gradually going to work lower $10 over the next week or so," he said.
"Seasonality wise, demand weakens this time of the year, plus we have better run time once we get beyond the holiday and fumigation type issues," the dealer added.
Another dealer said he believed the nearby interior market of Oklahoma and Kansas was under pressure. "I just think there are too many midds around and they cannot find homes for them," he said.
